about.title: About
about.description: What ePharmatica is: a learning platform and professional community for pharmacy, from Pakistan to the world.
about.intro: ePharmatica is a web platform with two connected halves: a learning platform delivering structured, visual study material covering the HEC-approved Pharm-D syllabus — written notes paired with videos and AI study tools that run on your own key — and a professional community for the pharmacists of Pakistan, open to the world: a discussion forum, an editorial blog, a curated jobs portal, and a resume builder.
about.review: Every piece of study and blog content passes review by an external licensed pharmacist before publication — authors never approve their own work.
